name: PrismaticBurst-TS-TW
title: Prismatic Burst
description: A full-bleed shader shoots soft rays of magenta, teal and blue outward from a black centre and slowly turns them. The colours cycle, giving a dark page a glowing light-burst backdrop.
use: A launch or event page needs a loud, colourful glow behind big headline type.
avoid: Busy moving rays compete with small text and feel like noise on calm, content-heavy pages.
a11y: Pure canvas effect with nothing to label, and it ignores reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Rays of magenta, teal and deep blue fan out from a dark middle and reach the edges of the stage. The beams are soft and blurred, brightest near the centre, with black gaps between them.
behaves: The fan of rays rotates slowly and its colours drift, some beams brightening as others dim. It runs from the moment it loads and never comes to rest.
customise: Intensity, speed, colour list, ray count, distortion, blend mode and animation mode are props; the shader itself needs a source edit.
weight: heavy: A full-screen fragment shader marching 44 steps per pixel on every frame.
demo: Six pink, purple and cyan rays bursting from the middle on black.
polishWhy: Vivid, well-blended rays with smooth colour cycling; the flat black centre is familiar.
